name: 3D title flythrough
description: Three.js title on a transparent background: extruded letters (Inter, real font outlines) flip forward and drop into place one by one while the camera pushes in from a high, offset angle; an accent rule draws under the title, an optional second line rises letter by letter, and it ends on a readable front-facing hold; use for chapter/episode titles, launch and keynote openers, or a hero line over footage (auto two-line layout in 9:16).
